tagline: Websites & automations for UK small businesses
heroTitle: Websites that win you customers. Automations that save you hours.
heroSubtitle: You're brilliant at what you do — your website and admin should be too. I hand-code fast, custom websites and set up the automations that answer enquiries, take bookings and collect reviews for you, so no customer is ever left waiting and you get your evenings back.
aboutTitle: Hi, I'm the person behind BisoDesign.
aboutText:
I started BisoDesign because I kept seeing the same thing: brilliant local businesses losing customers to competitors who simply had a better website and answered faster. Not better work — just better systems.

So that's what I build. Websites written in pure code — no drag-and-drop builders — that load fast, rank well and make it effortless for customers to call you. And the automations behind them that reply, book, remind and follow up for you, even when you're on a job or asleep.

When you work with me, you work with me. No account managers, no outsourcing, no jargon. You get a fixed price before anything starts, honest advice about what you actually need (and what you don't), and someone who still answers your message after launch. Your business matters to you — so it matters to me.
whatsappMessage: Hi! I'd like to talk about a website project.

portfolio.title: Sayah Recovery
portfolio.description: Website for a vehicle & HGV recovery company in North London. Built so stranded drivers can get help in seconds: SOS call buttons, a WhatsApp button that shares the driver's GPS location automatically, a moderated customer review system with its own admin panel, and local SEO (schema.org + sitemap). Hand-coded in HTML, CSS & JavaScript with Firebase.

faq.question: How long does a typical project take?
faq.answer: Anywhere from 2 to 8 weeks depending on the package and scope. Automations on their own often take just a few days. You'll know the timeline before we start.

faq.question: What kind of automations can you set up?
faq.answer: Anything that saves you repetitive admin: enquiries sent straight to your phone, online bookings with reminders, instant replies and follow-ups, review requests after a job, payment links and invoices. Tell me what you do by hand every week and I'll tell you honestly what can be automated.

faq.question: Why hand-coded instead of Wix, Squarespace or WordPress?
faq.answer: Hand-coded sites load faster, rank better on Google, have no plugins to break or get hacked, and don't lock you into a monthly platform subscription. You own the code — it's yours for good.

faq.question: I'm a small business — is this really for me?
faq.answer: Especially for you. Small businesses feel every missed call and every lost evening. Everything I build is sized to your budget, and we can start with one small automation and grow from there.

faq.question: What happens if I need changes after launch?
faq.answer: Small fixes and tweaks are covered for a short period after launch. After that, a simple monthly care plan or one-off changes — whatever suits you.

faq.question: Do you work with clients outside the UK?
faq.answer: Yes — most of the process happens over calls and messages, so location isn't a barrier.

faq.question: I don't have content or photos ready. Is that a problem?
faq.answer: Not at all — most clients start exactly there. I'll help you write the text, use quality images for now, and swap in your own photos whenever you're ready.

faq.question: What if I'm not sure what I need?
faq.answer: That's completely normal. Tell me what's frustrating you and I'll recommend the simplest thing that solves it — even if that means you need less than you thought.
